rationale_overall: The cap dropped from 5 to 3 this rebalance, forcing a trim rather than an add. NVDA, MSFT, and GOOGL are kept as the three strongest, most differentiated AI-wave exposures: NVDA posted record Q4 FY22 data-center revenue (Feb 16 2022), MSFT's Azure grew 46% (Jan 25 2022), and GOOGL highlighted deep AI investment (Feb 1 2022). AAPL and SPY are removed as the two weakest thematic holds. Pass-1 discovery across the other named waves surfaced no ticker strong enough to displace the three AI incumbents, and no adds are permitted this call since the cap fell below the current watchlist size.
